parts:
**Project 01: contract note filed (nothing git-committed)**

The proposal's first deliverable is now in your repository:

- **The note.** The normalization and transfer-contract note is in `01_dirichlet_newman_families/notes/`.
- **Check programmes.** Its two check programmes and their JSON records are in `numerics/`.
- **Updated READMEs.** The project, notes, numerics, source-documents and reviews READMEs now describe the new files.
- **Project copy.** A copy of the note is saved in the RH4 project.

The Codex audit the proposal requires has not been done yet.

**Findings**

- **Normalization.** The note fixes the family in Dobner's normalization for both parities, including the conjugate relation H_{t,χ̄}(z) = conj H_{t,χ}(−z̄).
  - So Λ_χ̄ = Λ_χ, and "both height directions" means x ≥ 0 for χ and for χ̄.
  - Checked on 16 characters against an independent Hurwitz-zeta evaluation (agreement to 4·10⁻⁹) and against LMFDB zeros (3·10⁻¹³).
- **A baseline the proposal and setup review did not use.** De Bruijn's strip theorem turns a zero-free half-plane Re s > B into Λ_χ ≤ (2B−1)²/2, uniformly in χ.
  - Liu's claimed B_new gives **0.2812**. The internally audited 11/12 chain gives 25/72.
  - Both are conditional on those preprint claims.
- **First bounded test.** Platt's verification budget is L ∈ [16.58, 17.02].
  - Transferring Polymath's parameter row consistently means scaling y₀ as well as t₀. That gives about **0.30**, which is above 0.2812.
  - So the stopping answer fixed before the run demotes first-term dominance at existing verification heights.
  - The review's 0.28–0.29 kept y₀ fixed, which does not preserve the dominance budget.
- **Correction to setup review §2.3.** At height zero the effective log conductor is about log(q/215) for even characters and log(q/9.3) for odd ones.
  - So for large q, one exterior estimate proved down to height zero would cover every zero.
  - The density crux therefore matters only for an intermediate range of q.
- **Hakimoglu-Brown's strip comparison carries over to the family.**
  - His paired-zero inequality holds for every primitive χ (Proposition 3.3, proved).
  - Its input S has an exact time-zero floor at every height (Lemma 3.4, proved).
  - With no half-plane input, the planning values (odd–even) are: 0.38–0.39 at q = 10⁴, 0.31–0.32 at 10⁶, 0.25–0.26 at 10⁸ and 0.19 at 10¹².
  - Per character at Platt's heights, the planning value is 0.26.
  - These are planning numbers, not bounds.
- **Proposed staging (answers C4–C6, C8, C12).**
  - First, Target A: every χ above an explicit conductor, by the strip comparison. It rests on two open inputs:
    - Lemma A_p: the floor of S persists along the flow, uniformly in x and q.
    - H12: uniform confinement of the nonreal zeros.
  - Second, Target B: small conductors, one character at a time.
  - Target C stays dormant.
  - The next task is to write Lemma A_p. No conductor sweep comes before it.

**Checks**

- **Same-model subagent check.** A Claude subagent re-derived the main identities and every planning number. It found three issues, all fixed. This is not independent review.
- **Reproducibility.** Both records reproduce byte-for-byte on your computer (Python 3.10, aarch64) and in the cloud (Python 3.13, x86_64).
- **Links.** All local links in the files I touched resolve.
- **Hygiene check.** It flags two broken links in Investigation 19 to an unbuilt PDF. These were already there and are unrelated to this work.

**Chat record**

- This session is chat 1 in the project's `claude-cowork` registry.
- The capture reports a gap from 23:51 to 01:02 New York time. The context compaction rewrote the transcript before that window was read, so the early progress lines and your preprint-upload message are missing from it.
- The claude.ai export can fill the gap via `record_Claude_export_chat.py`.

**Sources:** [Dobner, arXiv:2005.05142](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.05142) · [Polymath, arXiv:1904.12438](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.12438) · [Platt, arXiv:1305.3087](https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.3087) · [Liu, arXiv:2610.12234](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12234) · [Hakimoglu-Brown, arXiv:2610.12803](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12803) · [Andrade–Chang–Miller, arXiv:1310.3477](https://arxiv.org/abs/1310.3477) · [Stopple, arXiv:1301.3158](https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.3158) · [LMFDB Dirichlet characters](https://www.lmfdb.org/Character/Dirichlet/)
